short_description: Download & Save GoHighLevel Videos Easily for Offline Viewing (Browser Extension)
long_description: GoHighLevel Downloader is a browser extension built for users who want a simpler way to save training and course videos from GoHighLevel-powered portals. It works with supported GoHighLevel-hosted streams and common embedded lesson providers, giving you a browser-first workflow for detecting the lesson video, choosing a quality, and exporting an MP4 file you can replay later.

faqs.question: What kinds of GoHighLevel videos can I download?
faqs.answer: Supported GoHighLevel lesson videos plus supported embedded lesson players inside GoHighLevel portals and memberships.

faqs.question: Do I need to press play first?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many lesson streams are only exposed after playback begins.

faqs.question: What file format do downloads use?
faqs.answer: Videos are saved as MP4 files.

faqs.question: Does it support embedded lesson providers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Supported platforms include Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, and YouTube when they appear on supported GoHighLevel pages.

faqs.question: Do I need extra software?
faqs.answer: No. Everything runs through the browser extension.

why: GoHighLevel portals often mix native video delivery with embedded training players like Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, and YouTube. That creates a messy download experience because there is no built-in portal-wide export flow, and generic downloader tools do not recognize the full GoHighLevel environment reliably.

GoHighLevel Downloader is built for that exact use case. It focuses on supported portal and membership pages, detects the available lesson media in your browser session, and gives you a direct way to save accessible training content as MP4.
how_it_works: Install the extension from the latest release.
Open a GoHighLevel membership, course lesson, or portal page with video.
Start playback so the extension can detect the lesson media.
Open the popup to review available stream options.
Download the lesson and save the final MP4 file locally.
tutorial: Install GoHighLevel Downloader from the latest GitHub release.
Sign in to the GoHighLevel portal or membership area where you have access.
Open the lesson page you want to save.
Let the page load fully and press play on the lesson video.
Click the extension button in your browser toolbar.
Review the detected stream or embedded player options.
Select the quality you want to keep.
Start the download and wait for the MP4 export to finish.
Open the saved file from your Downloads folder.

The page requires login or membership access The extension only works on content you can already access in your active GoHighLevel session.
The extension does not activate on this site Make sure you are on an actual GoHighLevel-powered portal or membership page, not a different platform.

about: GoHighLevel is used for memberships, training portals, client education, and course delivery. Because those pages can mix native lesson media with several embedded platforms, there is no single clean built-in export workflow for viewers. GoHighLevel Downloader simplifies that process for users who need a local MP4 copy of accessible training content.
